evidence.snippet: Adobe Commerce on Cloud , Adobe Commerce on-premises, and Magento Open Source all use the same REST API
Create a new integration on Admin. To create an integration, click System > Extensions > Integration > Add New Integration**.

decisions.reason: Magento Open Source is free/self-hostable and any store admin can self-create an integration with OAuth credentials at no cost, no vendor approval needed.

evidence.snippet: Adobe Commerce REST APIs support multiple authentication methods , including:
OAuth authentication with Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source is based on OAuth 1.0a
Both of these authentication methods require every request to be signed with an IMS Access Token.

decisions.reason: Pages describe OAuth 1.0a (closest enum is oauth2, though technically 1.0a), token-based auth sent as Bearer for SaaS, and session/login-credential auth which falls under other.

decisions.reason: Any merchant/admin can self-create an integration and get credentials with no external approval, review, or paid plan required to build and test.

Adobe Commerce provides a wide range of REST API endpoints that allow you to perform actions on behalf of Commerce administrators, customers, and guest shoppers.

decisions.reason: Documented REST/GraphQL/SOAP APIs with self-serve credential creation (OAuth integration via Admin) and no external gating described in the pages, so a toolkit could be built today.
